> Blog · Prestige · 2026-08-01

# Brief
- Title: Sewer Backups in the Lowcountry: Causes, Warning Signs, and What to Do
- Slug: /blog/sewer-backup/. Role: PILLAR of the sewer cluster. Intent: informational (TOFU). About 1,925 words.
- Primary keyword: sewer backup. Secondaries: what to do after a sewer backup, sewer backup after heavy rain, how to prevent sewer backup, multiple drains backing up at once, sewer backup Bluffton SC.
- Title tag: "Sewer Backups: Causes, Signs & What to Do | Prestige Plumbing". Author: Matt Milunec.

# Outline
What a sewer backup is (the lateral, lowest exit; the draft notes most guides assume a basement, which Lowcountry homes usually lack), causes, why backups happen after heavy rain here, warning signs, what to do the moment sewage backs up, homeowner vs utility responsibility, prevention (including a backflow preventer), and an FAQ.

# Flag status (from the draft)
- Author page resolved (reuses the /about/ author block).
- The insurance section is factual and sourced, and tells readers to ask their own agent. It can be published, but the draft suggests a review.
- Lateral responsibility is stated as a general principle. Confirm it before publish (Hilton Head has separate public service districts).
- First-hand proof is optional.
- The backflow preventer mention is plain text for now. Add the link to /blog/backflow-preventer/ once that post is live (marked with a BUILD NOTE comment in the HTML).
- Gated for Scott: camera, hydro-jetting and repair pricing, free estimate language, warranties, emergency rates.

# Status
Drafted and built 2026-08-01, scheduled as drip Day 0. Not yet published per the cluster list.
